sources.title: General Directorate of Passports and Immigration: counter entry visa remains in operation
sources.publisher: General Directorate of Passports and Immigration, Ministry of Interior
sources.officialityEvidence: The General Directorate publishes its 3 August 2025 official newspaper on passports.gov.sd. It identifies the Directorate as the competent counter-visa authority and says approval is through its headquarters.
sources.supportingExcerpt: تأشيرة الدخول عند الوصول ما تزال إجراءً رسمياً معمولاً به.

sources.title: General Directorate of Passports and Immigration: foreigner entry and residence procedures
sources.publisher: General Directorate of Passports and Immigration, Ministry of Interior
sources.officialityEvidence: The Directorate published this November 2025 interview with its Foreigners Department director on passports.gov.sd. It describes current visa classes, sponsor/host conditions and the 2020 foreigners regulation but no nationality schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: هناك عدة أنواع من التأشيرات، منها: تأشيرة زيارة وتأشيرة سياحة.

sources.title: Government of Sudan: Port Sudan International Airport operations and passport police
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Sudan
sources.officialityEvidence: The current sudan.gov.sd government news report of 1 June 2026 records operating Port Sudan airport controls and directions to Passport Police at Sudanese airports; it publishes no visa nationality scope.
sources.supportingExcerpt: شرطة الجوازات بكافة مطارات السودان بالالتزام بالتواجد المتواصل.

sources.title: Transitional Constitutional Document (2025 amendment): citizen right to return
sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice, Republic of Sudan
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry of Justice’s current official-download index labels this as the Transitional Constitutional Document (2025 amendment); its 23 February 2025 announcement says the amendments took effect that day.
sources.supportingExcerpt: لكل مواطن الحق في مغادرة البلاد وفقاً لما ينظمه القانون وله الحق في العودة.

policies.title: Sudanese citizens’ constitutional right to return
policies.summary: A Sudanese citizen travelling on an ordinary Sudanese passport has a constitutional right to return; this is not a visitor-visa route for foreign nationals.
conditions: Applies to Sudanese citizens; the constitutional text states that exercise is subject to law.
Does not establish a foreign-national visa route, residence entitlement, work authorization, or exemption from security and admissibility controls.
